snippet.title: Fluffy Rumble - Official Playtest Launch Trailer | Party Game on Steam
snippet.description:
Fluffy Rumble is a lively collection of unforgettable mini-games, each bringing its own unique twist and challenging players in different ways. Play with friends in party mode or embark on a journey of incredible competitions in the single-player campaign with cute fluffy characters.
Fluffy Rumble will be featured on the Baltic Showcase 2026. The event goes live from June 15 to June 21. Playtest begins from June 15. Registration for Playtest is open on Steam.
